brief: GS Financials & REITs desk color, Oct 27. The AI trade is reasserting itself (AI-at-risk basket +6%, Datacenters +4% with DC REITs +2-3%, AI Semis +3%), creating a factor setup that favors high-beta momentum and crowded shorts over low-volatility defensives. Within Financials, Large and Trust banks are outperforming Regionals while Alts trade choppy. Defensives are leaking lower intraday: Senior Housing REITs are down 4-6% and Exchanges are weak (CME -4%) on positioning/factors rather than fundamentals, and P&C insurance bears are vocal on negative read-throughs (reinsurers, RYAN from BRO, workers comp from HIG) though the group stabilized after a weak morning. Despite bearish P&C positioning, no real buying defense has emerged in Senior Housing REITs or Exchanges, as investors are wary of fighting what may be an early-stage factor regime shift ahead of FOMC. Separately, the desk fields earnings-season inbounds: pushback against PFG's post-print rally, vocal SPGI bulls despite its strategic review, SOFI up mid-teens against crowded shorts, and mixed-but-positive feedback on TFC's asset sale, which Nash's note calls accretive given an 80bps ROA on the business versus TFC's 1.1% Q3 ROA.
